profile.Name: Crab Queen
profile.Personality: Devoted to crabs, which she calls strong, loyal, smart, and affectionate. Open-minded toward anyone who respects crabs, and contemptuous of anyone who would eat one.
profile.Backstory: She leads the Crab Raiders of Crab Town in the Pits, who keep crabs as companions and fight enemies in the Pits.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Calls outsiders 'crabless' and her people 'the crabbed'; asks what you know of crabs.
